QuestInfo.name: Neinheart the Skeptic
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has no faith in you or your abilities.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart says he needs to test you to trust you.\r\nTalk to the Chief Knight of Light, #bMihile#k, who will meet you on the way to the Knights Chamber.
QuestInfo.2: The first test takes place in Kerning Square.
